definition: MapDB is a Java library for collections that can store data on disk or in memory.
entry_text: MapDB is a Java library for collections that can store data on disk or in memory.
example: A Java application keeps a large key-value index on disk using a persistent map.
label: MapDB

sources.note: The project identifies MapDB as both an embedded Java database engine and a collections library with off-heap and on-disk storage.
